No. 2134/41 – WEDNESDAY, JULY 31, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No.: KWDS/LND/01/ACQ/111/2017. Land Ministry No. : 4-3/15/1/2017/VE/411.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act as Land Acquisition (Amended) act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire following land / servitude which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land or Servitude to be Acquired:

The allotment of known as Puhulpelpola/Kiripussayahena and shown as lot 1401 sheet number 08 and Supplement number 08 (01 block) of land in total extend of about 2.5015 hectares F.V.P. 946 situated Weddagala Village and Weddagala West Grama Niladhari Division in Meda Pattu of Kukulu Korale in Kalawana Divisional Secretariat Division of Ratnapura District Sabaragamuwa Province.
1. Lot No. 1401 In F. V. P. 649 Name of the land: Puhulpalpola; Name and Address of the Claimant: Mrs. D. K. D. Tewarapperuma, Asiri Mawatha, Battaramulla ; Extent: 2.5015 Hectares.
For Public purpose : The Acquisition of the Land for supplying optional lands for displaced families.

All persons interested in this land should be appear personally on 25th day of October, 2019 at 10.00 a.m., Kalawana Divisional Secretariat and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (with 2 duplicates) on or before the 15th day of October 2019, and nature of interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
SANJEEWANI KANDAMBI, Divisional Secretary, Kalawana.
At Divisional Secretariat of Kalawana, 24th July, 2019.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

My No.: Dehi/2-1/Ath/749. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land or Servitude to be Acquired : Allotments of the lands in total Extent about 0.0654 Hectares depicted in Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9821, prepared by Survey General, situated in the village of Nugegoda, within Municipal Council Limits of Dehiwala - Mount Lavinia in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dehiwala in Colombo District in Western Province.

1. P.P. No. Co. 9821 Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Alubogahawatta, Asst. No. 147, High Level Road; Description : Garden, Contains 02 Permanent Buildings; Claimant: State; Original Claimant : Not be found; Extent: 0.0654 Hectare.

Investigation date : 1. P.P.Co 9821 Lot No. 01 - Date 16th October 2019. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s Office of Dehiwala on the 16th October 2019 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 09th October, 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. NALINI BALASUBRAMANIAM, Divisional Secretary, Dehiwala.
Divisional Secretariat, 154, Galle Road, Dehiwala. 29th July, 2019. 08 - 585
